recipes.name: Kopstootje
recipes.method: Fill the tulip glass to the brim with jenever. Lean down and take the first sip without lifting it, then chase it with the beer.

recipes.name: Advocaat with cream
recipes.method: Pour the advocaat into a small glass, top with a cap of lightly sweetened whipped cream and dust with cocoa. Eat it with a spoon.

recipes.name: Genever old fashioned
recipes.method: Stir the jenever, syrup and bitters over ice until cold. Strain over a large ice cube and twist the orange peel over the top.

recipes.name: Bessenjenever tonic
recipes.method: Fill a tall glass with ice, add the bessenjenever and top up with cold tonic. Squeeze in the lemon and stir once.

recipes.name: Improved Holland gin cocktail
recipes.method: Stir everything except the peel over ice, strain into a chilled coupe and twist the lemon peel over the drink. From Jerry Thomas, 1876.
